warnings.title: Yellow Rain Warning
warnings.description: Heavy rain is expected to affect parts of Wales and South West England, potentially causing localized flooding of homes, businesses, and transport links. Spray and flooding will lead to difficult driving conditions and some road closures.

warnings.title: Amber Thunderstorm Warning
warnings.description: Severe thunderstorms are active across the East Midlands and East Anglia, producing very heavy downpours, frequent lightning strikes, hail, and strong gusts. Fast flowing or deep floodwater is possible, causing danger to life.

warnings.title: Yellow Wind Warning
warnings.description: Strong southwesterly winds will develop across western Scotland, with gusts of 55-65 mph possible. Some delays to road, rail, air, and ferry transport are likely, with high waves affecting coastal communities.
